More critically, the relation definition requires TARGET to be an object/entity, which 'small particles' are, but the causal link described in the text is vapor -> condensation -> droplets on particles, not condensation acting on particles. The quote supports 'vapor acts on small particles' or 'condensation occurs on small particles', not 'condensation acts on small particles'.
